parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
The investigation of the medieval town of Deborah on the Western bank of the Nile between the modern villages was deliberately planned to gather a maximum amount of information on the domestic aspects of medieval Nubian life. The objects found and the nature of some of the buildings were more elaborate than had been anticipated.

The first tribe in this area dates back ten thousand years, although some experts argue it was fifteen thousand years ago, though further empirical evidence is needed to support these two periods. The site was abandoned and covered with windblown sand just north of the Sudan frontier, revealing a cemetery far larger than any previously found in Nubia.

Such conducted by members of the expedition from 1972 to 1973 showed that although the tombs had been plundered and burned, the fragments of pottery and objects found were numerous, varied, and of high quality. Paintings dating from the same period were discovered as well. They were found on many temple walls in Nubia signifying the unification of upper Egypt, represented by the Lotus, with lower Egypt, represented by the Papyrus.

Modern physical anthropology goes beyond measuring indicators such as skull size or body weight. It attempts to reconstruct the entire biological structure of a population or a segment of a population. The expedition examined a total of 107 skeletons from children and women. Questions arose: where were the women buried, and why did some of the children receive the same distinctions as grown men?

Several female corpses were found to have unusually large teeth among this period's skeletons. Surprisingly, a large number were found to have lost their teeth at a comparatively early age, twenty-five to thirty-five. Additionally, archaeologists investigated the fingers and bones of women to find answers to these questions. A large collection of remains representing 1546 individuals dating from the beginning to the end of the Christian period around 1500 AD was submitted for computer analysis. The age distribution shows that the Nubian population, as a rule, died at an early age.

The expedition examined the tomb of an official in the Egyptian administration. We even have a clear enlargement of a photograph of his big toe, with detailed shape and fragments held in the museum. What we discovered was that culturally there was no single Nubian people. Moreover, the people of Nubia had met diverse environmental circumstances with a wide range of adaptive social responses. Researchers are in pursuit of the Nubian people's homeland, lost to floods which are most likely the reason that pushed them to the edge.

Dental problems were a major concern. Evidently small stones in the grain were not separated, and therefore the teeth were damaged from making bread from grain without separating them first. A diet of such bread eventually ground the teeth away, exposing their roots to decay. During the harvest the heavier grain fell back to the threshing floor while the lighter chaff blew away. After collection the grain was placed on the ground, ready for milling, using a stone shaped like a rolling pin with a curve to match. The grinding surface moved back and forth, grinding the grain into flour. On the other hand, normal cavities were rare because of the absence of sugar. Egyptians had no sugar, nor could the average person afford it. Examination of mummies, both young and old, found severely worn teeth. Although Egyptians had specialists for many medical problems, dentistry was not one of these.

analyses.content: 录音提到该地区的第一个部落可以追溯到 10,000 年前。
The first tribe in this area dates back ten thousand years, although some experts argue it was fifteen thousand years ago, though further empirical evidence is needed to support these two periods.
你可能听到 fifteen thousand (15,000)，但那只是专家的争论观点，还没有确凿证据，主要的日期是 ten thousand。
Such conducted by members of the expedition from 1972 to 1973 showed that although the tombs had been plundered and burned, the fragments of pottery and objects found were numerous...
注意听年份的起始点 "from 1972"，不要只听到后面的 1973。
录音明确指出考察队是在 1972 到 1973 年间进行的。
Paintings dating from the same period were discovered as well. They were found on many temple walls in Nubia signifying the unification of upper Egypt...
不要只写 walls，要加上修饰词 temple 才是完整的地点描述。
录音说这幅象征埃及统一的画作是在努比亚的许多 temple walls（寺庙墙壁）上被发现的。
The expedition examined a total of 107 skeletons from children and women.
答案是两个人群的并列，听到 skeletons from 后要迅速记下这两个词，缺一不可。
考察队总共检查了 107 具 children and women（儿童和妇女）的骨骼。

Several female corpses were found to have unusually large teeth among this period's skeletons. Surprisingly, a large number were found to have lost their teeth at a comparatively early age, twenty-five to thirty-five. Additionally, archaeologists investigated the fingers and bones of women to find answers to these questions.
你可能会因为前面一直在大篇幅讨论牙齿（teeth）而忽略了这里的并列项，一定要对“Additionally（此外）”这种补充信号词保持高度敏感。
录音在讲完牙齿（teeth）之后，补充说考古学家还调查了女性的“手指和骨头（fingers and bones）”来寻找答案。
录音提到有一张非常清晰的照片放大图，显示的是这位官员的 big toe（大脚趾）。
We even have a clear enlargement of a photograph of his big toe, with detailed shape and fragments held in the museum.
听到 "big toe" 可以只填 toe，但不要因为这个部位比较奇特而怀疑自己听错了。
Researchers are in pursuit of the Nubian people's homeland, lost to floods which are most likely the reason that pushed them to the edge.
题目中的 "finding" 对应录音中的 "in pursuit of"（追寻），不要填成 people 或 floods。
研究人员正在寻找努比亚人的 homeland（家园/故土），它因为洪水而失落了。
Evidently small stones in the grain were not separated, and therefore the teeth were damaged from making bread from grain without separating them first.
听到 stones 时最好带上修饰词 small，这能更准确地解释为什么它们混在谷物里没被发现。
牙齿磨损的原因是谷物中的 small stones（小石子）没有被分离出去。
During the harvest the heavier grain fell back to the threshing floor while the lighter chaff blew away. After collection the grain was placed on the ground, ready for milling...
不要听到 threshing floor 就填，那是谷物掉落的地方，准备研磨（ready for milling）时是放在 ground 上。
收获后，谷物被放在 ground（地面）上准备研磨。
On the other hand, normal cavities were rare because of the absence of sugar. Egyptians had no sugar, nor could the average person afford it.
题目是 "food didn't have"，对应录音中的 "absence of sugar"，不要被前面提到的大量面包（bread）干扰。
录音说正常的蛀牙很少见，是因为由于缺乏 sugar（糖）。
